title: BCC Ruling No. 07-42-1171 — climbing risk at warehouse exit-stair guards
code_edition: Ontario Building Code, Regulation 403/97 (as cited; amended)

facts.text: The case concerns twelve new exterior exit stairs at an existing one-storey Group F, Division 2 warehouse with a building area of 33,183 m².
The guard design included horizontal members between 140 mm and 900 mm above the level being protected.
The cited provision is Sentence 3.4.6.5.(8), addressing guard elements that may facilitate climbing.
